_comment: Only public job APIs/feeds meant for programmatic access. Each aggregator asks for attribution: the report links every job back to its source. Keep runs to a few per day.
user_agent: job-scout/1.0 (personal job search; contact via github.com/DrOpenSource)
_company_boards_help: Add companies whose careers page is hosted on Greenhouse (boards.greenhouse.io/<token>), Lever (jobs.lever.co/<token>) or Ashby (jobs.ashbyhq.com/<token>). The token is the last part of that URL. Unknown tokens are skipped and reported, never fatal. The starter tokens below are unverified guesses: run `python3 job_scout.py --check-boards` and delete the ones that fail.
